lines.en: label day121:
scene hall_day
I’m wandering the halls of the[school] during lunchtime, trying to figure out what I want to do today.
lines.zh: 午餐时间，我在[school]的走廊里闲逛，琢磨着今天该干点什么。

lines.en: I realized just a few minutes ago that I’d forgotten my wallet at home, and considering that this[school] is pure evil and does not offer free lunch to the staff-
lines.zh: 几分钟前我才想起来，我把钱包忘在家里了，而这所[school]又纯属恶魔，不给教职员工提供免费午餐——

lines.en: I am left with no other option but to either starve or mooch off of my students.
lines.zh: 所以我现在别无选择，要么饿死，要么去蹭学生的。

lines.en: The thing is, the cafeteria isn’t exactly a prime mooching spot since other staff members are in there, so I have to figure out a way around that.
lines.zh: 问题是，食堂算不上什么蹭饭的好地方，因为其他教职工也在里面，所以我得想个绕过去的办法。

lines.en: I am suddenly overcome by a strong urge to try my luck on the rooftop.
lines.zh: 我突然涌起一股强烈的冲动，想去天台碰碰运气。

lines.en: I don’t know much about anime, but one of the few things I do remember is that important characters always seem to be on the roof for some reason.
lines.zh: 我不太懂动画，但我记得的少数几件事之一，就是重要角色似乎总莫名其妙地待在天台上。

lines.en: I just hope that the door is unlocked since I still lack a key...
lines.zh: 我只希望门没锁，毕竟我还没有钥匙……

lines.en: scene black
scene roofnoon
I step out into the air only to be immediately assaulted by a level of humidity that makes this seem less like a roof and more like a sauna.
lines.zh: 我刚一走出去，就被一阵湿气迎面击中，这地方与其说是天台，不如说更像个桑拿房。

lines.en: At least the door was unlocked, though.
lines.zh: 不过至少门是开着的。

lines.en: I’m not really sure why, but I will gladly accept this convenient chain of events and chalk it up to a gift from God.
lines.zh: 我不太清楚为什么，但我很乐意接受这一连串方便的巧合，就当是 God 的恩赐吧。

lines.en: Now, to find someone who can give me food.
lines.zh: 现在，去找个能给我饭吃的人。

lines.en: scene black
scene makotoroof1
A diligent girl wraps her fingers around the chainlink before her, staring out at a city she isn’t allowed to leave.
lines.zh: 一个勤奋的女孩双手握在面前的铁丝网上，凝视着一座她不被允许离开的城市。

lines.en: But despite the inability to ever go somewhere bigger, at least at this point in time, she understands this town has everything others could offer and more.
lines.zh: 尽管至少在眼下，她永远无法去往更大的地方，但她明白这座小镇拥有其他地方能提供的一切，甚至更多。

lines.en: And so she stands here, in this place of quiet contemplation that others would view as a refuge, and wonders-
lines.zh: 于是她站在这里，站在这个别人会视为避难所的静思之地，思索着——

lines.en: Why try so hard if I can never escape?
lines.zh: 既然永远逃不出去，那为什么要这么努力？

lines.en: : Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotoroof2
: Ah, what?! Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 啊，什么？！Sensei？！

lines.en: : What are you doing up here?
lines.zh: : 你跑到这儿来干什么？

lines.en: : Give me food.
lines.zh: : 给我点吃的。

lines.en: scene makotoroof3
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : You’re breaking at least fifteen different[school] rules by being on the roof during lunch. I will accept food in exchange for my silence.
lines.zh: : 你午餐时间待在天台上，已经违反了至少十五条不同的[school]规定。我愿意接受食物，作为封口费。

lines.en: : I am not...and I don’t even have any food.
lines.zh: : 我没有……而且我根本没带吃的。

lines.en: : If you don’t have any food, what’s your explanation for being on the roof right now?
lines.zh: : 如果你没带吃的，那你解释一下现在为什么会在天台上？

lines.en: : This place is reserved for delinquents and rendezvous between [young]anime-couples.
lines.zh: : 这地方是给不良少年和[young]动漫情侣幽会用的。

lines.en: scene makotoroof4
: Just so you’re aware, the student council has access to the roof as well.
lines.zh: : 先说清楚，学生会也是可以上天台的。

lines.en: : Yes, it may be for the sole purpose of monitoring whether or not other students are spending time up here, but that is beside the point!
lines.zh: : 是的，也许唯一的目的就是监视其他学生是不是在上面逗留，但那不是重点！

lines.en: : What are {i}you{/i} doing here, Sensei? I believe that is a much better question.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}在这儿干什么，Sensei？我觉得这个问题有意思多了。

lines.en: : Is it really, though? I feel like someone like me is more prone to visiting places like this than your archetype.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我觉得像我这种人，比你这种类型更容易出现在这种地方吧。

lines.en: scene makotoroof5
: Well...that may be true. But even someone like me feels the need to escape every now and then.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许是吧。但就算是像我这样的人，偶尔也会有想逃避一下的时候。

lines.en: : Well...if you’re ever looking for even more of an escape, I wouldn’t mind helping you-
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果你想逃得更彻底一点，我不介意帮你——

lines.en: scene makotoroof8
: Don’t you dare even think about saying what you’re about to say, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你想都别想把那句话说完，Sensei。

lines.en: : I will climb over this fence right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就翻过这个围栏。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot that escape rooms make you claustrophobic. My mistake.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我忘了密室逃脱会让你幽闭恐惧。我的错。

lines.en: I take a moment to look at the fence.
lines.zh: 我花了一点时间打量那道围栏。

lines.en: There’s no way she can climb that high.
lines.zh: 她不可能爬得了那么高。

lines.en: : That’s a big fence, Makoto. Do you think you’re physically capable of scaling it?
lines.zh: : 这围栏挺高的，Makoto。你觉得以你的体力爬得上去吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure, but I swear on Einstein’s grave that I will find out if you continue to push me.
lines.zh: : 我不确定，但我对着爱因斯坦的坟墓发誓，你要是再逼我，我就让你看看我爬不爬得上去。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。对不起。

lines.en: : Just to get back to that escape thing, though, is it really necessary for you to come to a place like the[school] roof?
lines.zh: : 不过回到「逃避」这件事上，你真的有必要跑到[school]天台这种地方来吗？

lines.en: : Couldn’t you just hang out in the library or something?
lines.zh: : 你就不能去图书馆之类的地方待着吗？

lines.en: scene makotoroof1
Makoto takes a moment to look back over the horizon and sighs to herself.
lines.zh: Makoto 花了一点时间回头望向地平线，独自叹了口气。

lines.en: It’s not a heavy sigh or anything like that. If anything, it’s more like the sound someone makes when they’re giving up on something.
lines.zh: 那不是沉重的叹息什么的。要说的话，更像是某个人放弃某件事时发出的声音。

lines.en: : I guess I could. The library is certainly more fitting for someone like me, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我想可以吧。图书馆确实更适合像我这样的人，不是吗？

lines.en: : After all, what could I possibly gain from coming somewhere like this?
lines.zh: : 毕竟，我来这种地方又能得到什么呢？

lines.en: : I’m not an artist or a writer or anything like that. There’s no ‘inspiration’ that I can leech from a pretty view.
lines.zh: : 我又不是艺术家或者作家什么的。再美的景色也榨不出什么「灵感」。

lines.en: : It’s just a different view of the same things I see when I’m walking down the street each day.
lines.zh: : 只不过是我每天走在街上看到的那些东西，换了个角度看而已。

lines.en: : Nothing more, nothing less...
lines.zh: : 不多不少，仅此而已……

lines.en: scene makotoroof9
: Why are you here, though, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 不过你为什么在这儿呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Didn’t I already tell you? I’m looking for food.
lines.zh: : 我不是说过了吗？我在找吃的。

lines.en: : And so...you came to the roof? I’m not quite following your reasoning.
lines.zh: : 所以……你跑到天台上来？我不太明白你的逻辑。

lines.en: : Well I forgot my wallet at home and just felt strangely compelled to come here for some reason instead.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我把钱包忘在家里了，然后不知怎么地就莫名被吸引到这儿来了。

lines.en: : Compelled by what?
lines.zh: : 被什么吸引？

lines.en: : Hunger?
lines.zh: : 饥饿？

lines.en: : Hmm...
: While it’s true that extreme hunger can often lead to irrational behavior, I can’t imagine that simply going a day without lunch would drive you to that point.
lines.zh: : 虽然极度饥饿确实常常导致非理性行为，但我不觉得仅仅一顿午饭没吃就能把你逼到那种地步。

lines.en: : Perhaps it was something else that brought you here?
lines.zh: : 也许是别的什么东西把你带到这儿来的？

lines.en: : Maybe a hidden urge to throw yourself from the top of a building?
lines.zh: : 也许是某种隐藏的冲动，想从楼顶一跃而下？

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Hm?
: Did I say something strange?
lines.zh: : 我说了什么奇怪的话吗？

lines.en: : It’s not uncommon for people to have thoughts like that. It’s not as if it’s revealing your true intentions or anything of the sort.
lines.zh: : 人有这种想法并不罕见。这又不是在暴露你的真实意图什么的。

lines.en: : But then again, Japan has one of the highest suicide rates in the entire world, so the likelihood of you following through would be marginally higher in some respects.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，日本的自杀率在全世界名列前茅，所以在某些方面，你真的去做的可能性会稍微高一点。

lines.en: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: What the fuck is she talking about?
lines.zh: 她到底在说什么鬼话？

lines.en: : Sorry for asking this all of a sudden but, are you okay?
lines.zh: : 抱歉这么突然问一句，不过你还好吗？

lines.en: scene makotoroof10
: Of course. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 当然。为什么这么问？

lines.en: : It’s not like you to randomly go off on depressing tangents like this.
lines.zh: : 你可不像是会突然冒出这么丧的话题的人。

lines.en: : Is it truly depressing if it’s based on logic and reason rather than emotion?
lines.zh: : 如果它是建立在逻辑和理性，而不是情绪之上，那还算「丧」吗？

lines.en: : I’m simply giving you the breakdown of my thought process. I didn’t intend to evoke any darker feelings.
lines.zh: : 我只是在把我的思考过程拆解给你听。我并没有打算唤起什么阴暗的情绪。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess if you say so...
lines.zh: : 我……好吧，既然你这么说……

lines.en: scene makotoroof11
: Apologies if any of that made you feel weird, though. I’ll try to be a bit more candid in the future.
lines.zh: : 不过如果刚才那些让你觉得不舒服，我道歉。我以后会尽量更坦率一些。

lines.en: : No need to apologize, just felt compelled to ask if you were doing alright after hearing that. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉，只是听了那些之后，我忍不住想问你还好不好。就这样。

lines.en: : Well then, yes. I’m totally fine. And thank you for caring enough to ask.
lines.zh: : 那么，是的。我完全没事。也谢谢你愿意关心到问一句。

lines.en: : It’s strange, though. It seems as if you’ve felt compelled to do several things today.
lines.zh: : 不过真奇怪。你今天似乎被驱动着做了好几件事。

lines.en: : First the roof, now this...Perhaps I should be the one checking on {i}you{/i} instead?
lines.zh: : 先是被吸引到天台，现在又是这个……也许该换成我来关心{i}你{/i}才对？

lines.en: scene makotoroof12
: Your mind hasn’t been taken over by someone else, has it? Hahaha~
lines.zh: : 你的脑子该不会被什么人接管了吧？哈哈哈~

lines.en: : Of course not. I don’t think things like that are even possible.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我觉得那种事根本不可能。

lines.en: scene makotoroof11
: Neither do I, of course. I was just trying to make a joke after dragging the mood down so much.
lines.zh: : 我当然也不觉得。我只是把气氛搞得这么沉之后，想开个玩笑而已。

lines.en: : Besides, if something like that {i}were{/i} possible, I’m sure I’d be the first to notice.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果{i}真有{/i}那种事，我肯定是第一个发现的。

lines.en: : You and I spend so much time together that there’s no way something as big as that could just slip by me.
lines.zh: : 我们俩待在一起的时间那么长，那么大的事我不可能就这么漏掉。

lines.en: I...wouldn’t be so sure of that if I were you, Makoto.
lines.zh: 我要是你的话，可不会这么肯定，Makoto。

lines.en: In fact, it seems like the first person to notice was actually the one I’m {i}least{/i} close with. How’s that for irony?
lines.zh: 事实上，第一个注意到的人似乎反而是和我关系{i}最{/i}疏远的那个。这算不算讽刺？

lines.en: scene makotoroof13
: Sorry in advance for getting sappy, but I wonder where I would be right now if the two of us never met?
lines.zh: : 先提前说声抱歉，我要煽情一下了——我在想，如果我们俩从未相遇，我现在会在哪里？

lines.en: : Sure, we’ve barely known each other for a year, but it feels like much longer.
lines.zh: : 当然，我们认识还不到一年，但感觉已经要久得多。

lines.en: : I’ve learned so much from you, even if you’ve sort of given up on the whole teaching thing.
lines.zh: : 我从你身上学到了很多，哪怕你在教书这件事上基本已经放弃了。

lines.en: : Hey, I haven’t given up. I’m just trying out new methods.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可没放弃。我只是在尝试新方法。

lines.en: : Well, whatever you’re doing, it seems to be working.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管你在做什么，看起来挺有效的。

lines.en: : Everyone’s grades are up and the last set of standardized tests were lifelong highs for almost everyone involved.
lines.zh: : 每个人的成绩都提高了，而且上一轮统考几乎是所有人的历史最高分。

lines.en: scene makotoroof14
: I’m going to take some of the credit for that if you don’t mind, though. I’ve been doing my fair share as well.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你不介意的话，这份功劳我要分走一些。我也出了我那份力。

lines.en: : Hell, you can take all of the credit if you want. Like you said, I barely even do anything.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，你要是想的话，功劳全拿去都行。就像你说的，我基本什么都没干。

lines.en: : I’m kind of just moral support at this point while all of you figure out how to do stuff on your own.
lines.zh: : 我现在大概就是个精神支柱，而你们自己想办法搞定一切。

lines.en: : Hahah~ Well moral support is always important too, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哈哈~不过精神支持也很重要啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Plus, there are always other things you can do to help us other than just explaining chemistry and things of the sort.
lines.zh: : 再说，除了讲解化学之类的东西，你总有别的办法能帮到我们。

lines.en: : That’s great. This might be a shocker to you, but chemistry is definitely not one of my strong points.
lines.zh: : 那太好了。这对你来说也许有点冲击，但化学绝对不是我的强项。

lines.en: : Oh? And what {i}are{/i} your strong points, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦？那 Sensei 你的强项{i}是{/i}什么？

lines.en: : Sex education.
lines.zh: : 性教育。

lines.en: scene makotoroof15
: Okay. I think it’s about time to head back downstairs.
lines.zh: : 好了。我想差不多该下楼了。

lines.en: scene black
And so the two of us head back downstairs.
lines.zh: 于是我们俩下楼去了。

lines.en: Makoto locks the door behind us, ensuring that I won't be able to come up here again without getting a key from either her or Yumi.
lines.zh: Makoto 在我们身后锁上了门，确保我没法不从她或 Yumi 那儿拿到钥匙就再上来。

lines.en: Of course, she’s blissfully unaware that Yumi even {i}has{/i} a key at the moment, so I just need to make sure she doesn’t find out if I ever want to come up here again...
lines.zh: 当然，她现在完全不知道 Yumi 手上{i}有{/i}钥匙，所以只要我以后还想上来，就得保证她不会发现……

lines.en: $ day121 = True
$ makoto_love += 1
{i}Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]!{/i}
